title: RUSCUAV v2.0.0: Semantic Mission-Acceptability Benchmark for Low-Altitude Urban Cargo-UAV Navigation
description: RUSCUAV v2.0.0 is the reproducibility release for a semantic mission-acceptability benchmark for low-altitude urban cargo-UAV navigation. It contains source code, synthetic worlds, trained PPO weights, primary no-terminal and secondary operational-stopping per-episode results, static and dynamic planners, five-seed policy evaluations, multi-world morphology-shift results, Vienna/Warsaw real-GIS simulation outputs, paper-ready tables and figures, complete Holm families, provenance manifests, and the manuscript and supplementary PDFs. Processed Vienna/Warsaw NPZ worlds are excluded; generation scripts and AOI metadata are included.
